'''Matteus Zaym''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Prince/Legends|prince]] of the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] who lived [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] after the [[Xim Wars|collapse]] of the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot's]] [[Xim's empire|empire]]. During a period of [[Politics/Legends|political]] turmoil in the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]], the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] prince fled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kaon]] there to avoid [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]]. Using his remaining wealth, Zaym rebuilt the former [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] world, growing its trade [[Spaceport/Legends|ports]] and investing in the arts. From his palace, Zaym gradually turned Kaon into a peaceful and cultured retreat for the [[Noble/Legends|nobility]] of the Tion Cluster.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Matteus Zaym was first mentioned in the Codex entry for the planet Kaon in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" /> The Codex entry, along with the rest of the "Kaon Under Siege" Flashpoint, was added to the game as part of Game Update 1.1: "Rise of the Rakghouls" in [[2012]].<ref name="Update">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/1.1.0/rise-rakghouls|text=Game Update 1.1: Rise of the Rakghouls Patch Notes}}</ref>
